spans.s: Senābindu^1 (C. Senāvindu), one or more kings. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2656 (incarnation of the Asura Tuhuṇḍa). --§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6989 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1019, 1022 (Devaprasthaṃ…Sºoḥ puraṃ, vanquished by Arjuna). --§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 76.--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 171, 5912 (Krodhahantā ca nāmataḥ, a ratha among the Pāṇḍavas).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 21, 916; 23, 975 (description of his horses).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 7, 179 (ºsutaḥ śreshṭhaḥ, so both B. and C., but PCR. seems to have read ºḥ sūtaśreshṭhaḥ, had been slain by Bālhīka), 182 (Kuruśreshṭhaḥ(!), the half-śloka omitted by PCR.).
Senābindu^2, a Pāñcāla prince. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 48, 2248 (slain by Karṇa).

Senājit, name of one or more kings. § 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 76 (at the time of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 629 (Rājadh.): XII, 25, 744 (itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ…gītaṃ rājñā Sºtā, some ślokas of his quoted), 760.--§ 659 (Mokshadh.): XII, 174, 6464, (6468), 6521 (S.'s discourse with a brahman on account of the loss of a son).
Senānī^1, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4548. Cf. Senāpati.^1
Senāpati^1, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2732.--§ 581 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 64, 2837, 2841 (slain by Bhīmasena). Cf. Senānī^1.
